name: The Prophecy
description: When magic returns to the land, the world will be wiped clean. Possibly an Engineer subversion, but it seems to have a much older pedigree.

name: The Suppression of Magic
description: A book on magic and its suppression, in which the Seven Spheres appear. It is vague about what they are for, but clear enough that each one would set its finder up for life. Who wrote it, and when, is not known; nor how much it knew of [[event/spheres-scattered|their scattering]], or of the strands each sphere holds in check.
